description: How to analyse live and past KainBain tasks — where task folders live, where logs live (service logs, deploy log, session transcripts, per-task log entries), and how to inspect a task's state, history, reports, and failure reasons via the filesystem and the live API/WebSocket. Use when asked to investigate a task, debug a failed stage, trace a deploy, or audit what an agent did.

kbApiBase.description: KainBain API base URL for live task/status lookups (default; override with KAINBAIN_API_BASE where different).

projectCwd.description: Project root on disk; task folders live under docs/tasks/<id>/ below it. Resolved per stage run from the project's cwd.

deployDir.description: Deployed build directory holding the live build (api + frontend/dist + build.json). Default matches deploy.sh ($KAINBAIN_PROD_DIR or ~/apps/kainbain); override per stage for Docker/container layouts where the build lives inside the image, or leave as-is when this run has no deployed copy to inspect.
